items.x: **Choose your pathway.** Decide between 189, 190 and 491. Your occupation, points and willingness to live regionally drive this choice. Read the [visa comparison](/migrate-to-australia).

**Check your occupation.** Search the [Occupation Finder](/occupation-finder). Note the code and the assessing authority. If your occupation is not on any list, ask us about other options before you spend money.
**Take an English test.** Competent English is the minimum. Higher scores earn points. Book early, because results are valid for a limited time.

**Get a skills assessment.** Apply to the assessing authority for your occupation. You will usually provide identity documents, qualifications, transcripts, employment references and payslips or tax records. Processing times vary by authority.

**Calculate your points and lodge an EOI.** Use the [PR Points Calculator](/migrate-to-australia/pr-point-calculator) and read [how points are calculated](/skilled-migration/how-points-are-calculated). Lodge your Expression of Interest in SkillSelect. You need at least 65 points.

**Receive an invitation and lodge your visa.** You have a limited time after an invitation to lodge. Pay the visa application charge and upload your documents.

**Complete health and police checks.** You may need health examinations and police certificates for every country where you lived for a set period. See our [AFP police check](/afp-national-police-check) page. After the decision, check your visa conditions and the date by which you must first enter Australia.

faqs_add.q: What is the difference between a Maritime Crew visa and a Crew Travel Authority?
faqs_add.a: A Maritime Crew visa (988) is for crew arriving by sea on eligible ships. A Crew Travel Authority (942) is for airline crew and aircraft safety inspectors arriving by air. They are separate documents for separate kinds of travel.

faqs_add.q: Does crew need a visa to enter Australia?
faqs_add.a: Foreign crew generally need an appropriate visa or authority before arriving. Which one depends on how and why you travel, and on your citizenship. New Zealand citizens are treated differently. See our [Special Category visa (444)](/transit-special-purpose/special-category-visa-444) page.

faqs_add.q: Can I apply for a Maritime Crew visa from inside Australia?
faqs_add.a: No. You generally must be outside Australia when you apply for subclass 988.

faqs_add.q: Is there a fee?
faqs_add.a: Fees depend on the document and can change. Our own fees are set out in a written agreement before any work starts.

faqs_add.q: Can yacht crew use the 988 visa?
faqs_add.a: Generally not. Yacht crew usually do not qualify for the Maritime Crew visa. Contact us to check your situation.

faqs_add.q: Can I stay in Australia after my ship leaves?
faqs_add.a: Crew visas are made for crew work, not for staying on. If you want to stay, you would need to qualify for a different visa. Get advice before you act, as leaving the ship without the right visa can affect your future visa options.

faqs_add.a: Partners and dependent children are usually included in the same application.

faqs_add.q: If I am not selected, can I try again?
faqs_add.a: Generally yes, in a later ballot if you still meet the requirements.

faqs_add.q: Can an agent improve my chances in the ballot?
faqs_add.a: No. Selection is random. We can help you register correctly and prepare if you are selected.

faqs_add.q: What is the difference between the 151 and a Resident Return visa?
faqs_add.a: A Resident Return visa is for people who still hold permanent residence and want to keep travelling. The Former Resident visa is for those who no longer hold PR.

faqs_add.q: How is the visa assessed?
faqs_add.a: Against a points test and requirements such as past residence and ties.

faqs_add.q: What if I am an Australian citizen?

faqs_add.q: How long can I stay on a Transit visa?
faqs_add.a: Usually up to 72 hours.

faqs_add.q: Can I apply inside Australia?
faqs_add.a: No. You apply from outside Australia.

faqs_add.q: Can I change my flight after the grant?
faqs_add.a: Possibly, but you must still leave within the time allowed. Speak to us before you change plans.

faqs_add.q: Can I visit family in Melbourne during transit?
faqs_add.a: Only within the allowed stay and conditions. For more time, a visitor visa is better.

faqs_add.q: What if I already have another Australian visa?
faqs_add.a: Check your visa conditions first. Home Affairs warns that a new grant may affect an existing visa.

blocks.x: Family members who are not New Zealand citizens do not receive a 444. They need their own visa. Options may include a [partner visa](/family-visa), a [skilled visa](/migrate-to-australia) or a [visitor visa](/visitor-visa).

faqs_add.q: Do New Zealanders need to apply for a visa?
faqs_add.a: Most receive a 444 on arrival and do not apply in advance.

faqs_add.q: Is a 444 the same as permanent residency?
faqs_add.a: No. It is a temporary visa with long-term rights. Citizenship may be possible without PR first.

faqs_add.q: Can I get citizenship without PR?
faqs_add.a: Eligible 444 holders can apply directly.

faqs_add.q: Can my partner join me?
faqs_add.a: A non-New Zealand partner needs their own visa.

faqs_add.q: Can the 444 be cancelled?
faqs_add.a: Yes, for example for character reasons.

faqs_add.q: Can I vote?
faqs_add.a: Voting rules depend on citizenship and enrolment. Please ask us if you are unsure.

faqs_add.q: Can I apply for a Special Purpose visa?
faqs_add.a: No. It is held automatically by people in certain categories.

faqs_add.q: Is there a fee?
faqs_add.a: No application charge.

faqs_add.q: How do I know if I hold one?
faqs_add.a: Check your travel orders and your VEVO record, or ask your employer.

faqs_add.q: What happens when my duty ends?
faqs_add.a: The visa ends with the status. Leave, or apply for a different visa before then.

faqs_add.q: Can I work or study on it?
faqs_add.a: Depends on the category.

faqs_add.q: Is it the same as the 945?
faqs_add.a: No. The 945 is a travel authority registered for certain military personnel. See the [945 page](/transit-special-purpose/special-purpose-travel-authority-945).

If you want to stay in Australia after your posting, you need a visa that allows it. Options could include [skilled migration](/migrate-to-australia), [family visas](/family-visa) or [employer sponsorship](/employer-sponsored). Get advice well before your duty ends.

faqs_add.q: Can I apply for the 945 myself?
faqs_add.a: Generally no. It is arranged through official channels.

faqs_add.q: Which countries are covered?
faqs_add.a: Canada, Singapore, the United Kingdom and the United States have been reported.

faqs_add.q: Can my spouse come with me?
faqs_add.a: Eligible family members named on your orders may be covered.

faqs_add.q: Can I work in Australia on a 945?
faqs_add.a: Only for your official duties.

faqs_add.q: Can I take a holiday in Australia?
faqs_add.a: Private travel is a different matter. A visitor visa or eVisitor may apply.

faqs_add.q: What is the difference between this and the Special Purpose visa?
faqs_add.a: The Special Purpose visa is held automatically. The 945 is a registered authority for particular military personnel.
